name: Loess Hills
story: The Loess Hills are a grassland formation of wind-deposited loess soil in Iowa, USA. These hills rise 200 feet above the flat plains in a narrow band along the Missouri River. They feature unique peak and saddle topography and are home to species like big bluestem and little bluestem.
matters: The Loess Hills protect some of the last remaining stands of prairie grass in the region and provide essential thermal updrafts that raptors use during their migrations.
